ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; estimated 95:5 ratio of dark grey/black to high-intensity white point-features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a solid, dark contiguous field. Spatial mapping indicates a non-contiguous distribution of high-contrast white circular and linear micro-blobs scattered across the mid-section and distal margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; vertex is well-defined with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration. Trailing edge displays a jagged profile with numerous sharp peaks and deep valleys (approx. 5-12 pixels in depth) along the boundary from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a generally convex trajectory from the median notch, transitioning to an upward-swept concave curve near the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small, roughly circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the surface, with a high concentration on the left lobe and lower-central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions are visible; most prominent is a diagonal rake mark on the lower-left lobe and multiple short horizontal scratches on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable indentation or irregular excision on the superior-lateral margin of the left lobe tip, indicating historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a 'starry' pattern composed of high-density, high-contrast white point-marks against a near-uniform dark grey substrate.
